basis: Administrative control of the central lowlands and the major cities is not disputed by any party, including the opposition bodies. Shown at whole-state resolution; it does not mean uncontested control of every township within these units.

Sustained armed resistance and disrupted military administration across much of the northwest. Both sides operate throughout; neither holds it cleanly. Contested is the honest category here, not a hedge.

Resistance organisations operate across most of the state and an interim executive was established in 2023. State-wide shading overstates the uniformity of that reach and should be read alongside the Karenni case study.
The ULA/AA expanded territorial and administrative control across much of Rakhine State. Specific townships, and the position in Sittwe and Kyaukpyu, require separate township-level sourcing.

The UWSA has administered a self-governing territory on the Chinese border since 1989. It occupies a portion of Shan State only; whole-state shading is a limitation of the ADM1 resolution used here, not a claim about the whole state.
